setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device on OUT 1: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in C major at 90 BPM, with sixteenth-note steps (Rate /1). All Trig params slots are empty, and the Device page is showing.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Fixed Note makes the channel send one chosen MIDI note while the pattern still decides when. Turn E1 to Channel tasks, choose Trig params with E2 and press K3. Press K2 to open the parameter list and turn E3 until it shows Fixed Note.
steps.title: Find Fixed Note

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Fixed Note to the first slot and K2 to return. Slot 1 reads X, which means Off, so the parameter is assigned but sends nothing yet.
steps.title: Assign Fixed Note to a slot

steps.caption: With no step held, turn E3 to 60 (C3). Slot 1 reads C5, this slot's name for MIDI note 60 (it numbers octaves two higher than the C3 used elsewhere in this manual). This is the channel's default pitch, the note every step plays unless it has its own lock.
steps.title: Set the channel pitch

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. The MIDI strip lists four C3 (60) note-ons at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. The pitch is fixed and the velocities are not.
steps.title: Play the default

steps.caption: Hold step 2 at (2,4), turn E3 to 63 (D#3) and release. A value set on a held step is a lock, and it belongs to step 2 alone. Play, then stop: the strip reads 60, 63, 60, 60 (C3, D#3, C3, C3).
steps.title: Give step 2 another pitch

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4), turn E3 down to 0 and release. 0 is a real pitch, the lowest MIDI note (C-2), not Off. Play, then stop: the strip reads 0, 63, 60, 60.
steps.title: Zero is a note

steps.caption: Hold step 4 at (4,4), turn E3 down to X (Off) and release. X on a step means no lock, and step 4 had none, so a Play and Stop still gives 0, 63, 60, 60. Then, with no step held, turn E3 up five detents to raise the channel pitch to 65 (F3), and Play and Stop again: steps 3 and 4 follow the new default and steps 1 and 2 keep their locks, 0, 63, 65, 65.
steps.title: X is no lock; raise the default beneath the locks

steps.caption: Hold step 2, press K2 and release: its lock is gone, so Play and Stop gives 0, 65, 65, 65. Then, with no step held, turn E3 down to X (Off), and Play and Stop again: steps 2, 3 and 4 return to the written phrase, 62, 64, 65, while step 1 still plays its own lock, 0.
steps.title: Clear a lock, then turn the channel pitch off

steps.caption: Hold step 1, press K2 and release. With no lock and no channel pitch left, Play and Stop gives the original C, D, E, F phrase again: 60, 62, 64, 65.
steps.title: Clear the last lock
